text: The paper reports that workers are more accurate when they have access to text snippets and are most accurate in the PS condition, indicating no clear effect of the arguments. Both unanimous agreement (3/3 workers correct) and majority-vote agreement (at least 2/3 correct) show workers most accurate in PS and least accurate in P.
title: Snippets help but arguments do not: judges most accurate in snippets-only (PS) condition
